integrity: Analytical proof; reproducible finite checks are supplementary. Literature priority comparison has explicitly acknowledged residual risks.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the compact ideal of infinite-dimensional real or complex ell_p with 2<p<infinity.
No sharp claim for 1<p<2, general Banach spaces, or noncompact maps.
Classical exact adjoint-abelian classification is already known; only the sharp quantitative coefficient is claimed.
title: Sharp adjoint-abelian defect of compact operators on non-Hilbert sequence spaces
